notes.title: 3.0.1 Build Update and G-Star Event Participation
notes.content:
Hello, here is bluecrab project.

We've updated Diary of Lucie for the second time since the official release.
The direction of this update is to improve existing contents such as adding weapon storage boxes, improve automatic storage capabilities, and add Chinese translation.
In addition, Diary of Lucie will participate in the G-star 2023 event this November as an indie game booth.
Along with booth-only events, we are selling games at a 45% discount during the exhibition period, so please pay a lot of attention.
Please check the patch notes below for details.


[h2]1. Improvements to existing content[/h2]

[h3] Weapon Storage Box [/h3]
You can strengthen your weapons in various ways as you go into the second half, 
Many people said that they were uncomfortable because they could only strengthen one weapon.
So later in the content, I added a weapon storage box that I can unlock from my inner mind.
Storage and arms changes can be carried out in Lucie's room, and up to three can be stored depending on the release stage.

[h3] Reorganization of the reinforcement system[/h3]
So far, weapons have been strengthened indefinitely, 
The automatic storage function allowed us to forcibly reroll weapons and accessories options.
Although it was judged that this was not a big problem for the game progression,
In preparation for not re-rolling, problems such as low compensation and relative deprivation occurred.

Therefore, it was changed so that it could not be rolled when strengthening weapons or accessories,
Instead, the higher the enhancement options, the more likely they are to have better options.
In addition, the weapon can be strengthened only up to the 99th round, 
Accordingly, we controlled the physical strength and difficulty of the contents in the second half.

[h3] Weapon Changes [/h3]
Now, the heart of the Golem, the first weapon does not appear in the inner mind.
There was a slight decrease in the consumption of charging stamina for the cane and hammer.
Additionally, the full stack of the hammer's passion will now have an amplification effect on the charging attack.

[h3] Change in difficulty [/h3]
Easy mode is adjusted to significantly lower performance of the enemy compared to normal.
However, there was a problem that the enemy could not bear even if the item farming was well tightened in the second half.
- The physical defense of the enemy increases.
- Enemy's physical strength increases in the second half.

Hell Level has unconscionable capabilities and additional patterns as it is designed for later content.
However, we wanted to lower the durability in line with the improved weapon strengthening system.
(I added an extra spoonful of conscience.)
- The enemy's maximum strength has decreased.
- Modified the delay between attack patterns slightly slower.


[h2] Add Chinese translation[/h2]
Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese are now added to the translation language.
DLC will also be added to the translation language as soon as possible.


[h2] Fix other bugs[/h2]
The part that was not translated into English has been modified.
Fixed a phenomenon where the first message asking you to type any key did not appear at the start of the game.
Fixed a phenomenon in which pop-up information windows sometimes did not appear when acquiring properties and skills.
Fixed a phenomenon where hammer weapon full stack charging attacks are not applicable.
Fixed a phenomenon where hammer weapon tutorials sometimes don't come out.
Fixed an intermittent bug that prevented the player from moving when he returned to the lobby after he died.
Fixed a bug where certain items in the store cannot be purchased.
(Added) Fixed an issue where an error message was displayed when opening the accessory box after clearing the boss.
(Added) Fixed an issue where player could not move in the lobby after clearing the golem.
(Added) Fixed an issue where certain relic options were not applied when restarting.

notes.title: First major update! 3.0.0 Build Patch List
notes.content:
Hello, here is parange project.

Diary of Lucie has undergone a major update for the first time after official release.
The direction of this update is to add later content, reinforce the story and ending, and balance existing content.
The English and Chinese version builds will be released as soon as possible next week.
Please check the patch notes below for details.



[h2]1. Added new final boss and ending[/h2]
A new boss battle will now appear in the final stage.
When clearing the boss, a new ending scene, and ending credits have been added.
Now enjoy a more natural and complete story and ending than before.

In addition, the existing final boss has been modified to behave more naturally with the addition of behavioral patterns.


[h2]2. New Difficulty Hell mode added[/h2]
Starting from version 3.0.0, a new difficulty level: Hell Mode is added.
In hell mode, all actions of enemies become faster, especially new patterns are added to most bosses.
You can earn more credits and farming opportunities as it is more difficult than the previous difficulty.

Even though Diary of Lucie was designed based on a hardcore game, there were many opinions that it was too easy going backwards.
So, if the difficulty that has been revealed so far was added after the developer cleared it, the developer put down all restrictions and conscience to the point that it was impossible to clear the hell difficulty level that was added this time.
Enjoy until the clear comes out!


[h2]3. Update existing content[/h2]
[h3]items[/h3]
Most items with a duration limit are being disliked and we want to improve this.

The items below are changed to strengthen property damage with no duration limit.
- Scroll of Flame
- Scroll of Ice
- Scroll of Wind
- Scroll of Lightning

The items below are changed to stat enhancement with no duration limit.
- Donoot: HP recovery, critical hit increase
- Energy Drink: Immune to abnormal conditions, increase stamina
- Whiskey: Increases defense
- Cupcake: HP recovery, critical hit increase
- Shooting Star: Health recovery, balance increase

[h3] Skills [/h3]
We want to increase the utilization of skills that are relatively less preferred.
- Heat Breath: Total magic damage increased.
- Ice Ball: Changed from the existing continuous firing method to a method that shoots a large amount of ice balls at once.
- Cold Breath: Total magic damage increased.
- Tornado: Increased the range at which enemies are drawn in.
- London Rondo: Removed 2 spins of level 3 talent and increased spin damage by 100%. No longer stops on cast
- Mana Staff: Changed the mana acquisition amount to increase in all levels.
- Acceleration: Mana consumption reduced by 1 -> Changed to decrease by 2.
- Massive Haste: Instead of increasing base mana cost to 2, now reduces cooldown by 30% starting at level 1.
- Alprazolam: Now, starting from level 1, the damage increase is changed to the boss.
- Ice Crystal: Total magic damage increased. The number of attacks at level 3 is changed to 2 additional times.
- Railgun: Base fixed damage increased. Level 3 is changed to increase total damage instead of 2 attacks.

The skills below have a high performance-to-efficiency ratio, so I'd like to make some adjustments.
- Haste: Mana consumption is unified to 3.
- Fire Spear: Mana consumption is unified to 5, and spear damage is increased.
- flash: Mana consumption is unified to 4.
- Newclear Punch: All areas mana consumption is unified to 5.
- Thunder flash: Mana consumption in all areas is unified to 5. Increases physical damage.


[h3]weapon[/h3]
Memorize: Cooldown reduced by 10% -> Reduced by 20%
Staff of Mana: Increases charge speed and attack power.
Olympus: Increases magic attack power.


[h2] Relic[/h2]
The efficiency of items related to movement speed is low, so we want to increase the performance more.
Hunter's Instinct - Duration increased to 12 seconds, movement speed increased by 40%
Ring of Vitality - Increases stamina recovery by 35%
Golden Feather - Increase movement speed by 20%
Fire Gemstone - Increases fire property damage by 30%
Rings (Swamp Ring, Lava Ring, Frost Ring): Elemental resistance rate is unified at 100%.
Emerald Feather: Speed 30%
Umbrella: The chance of not consuming a potion is changed to 50%.
Scholar's Toshi: Changed to 3 mana recovery when entering a new room.
8BITDO Hand Mirror - Changed property damage to 50%

In addition, some enchantments and weapon enhancement options have been further balanced.


[h2]4. Intermediate save, auto save function added[/h2]
Changed so that progress is automatically saved whenever you arrive at a new floor.
This feature has been requested since the beginning of development, but was not added considering the possibility of abuse.
However, considering the high difficulty and increased play time, we decided that the auto save function could greatly reduce the stress.
Now, feel free to take a break in the middle and play!


[h2]5. New DLC: Expansion Pack added[/h2]
A new DLC will be released.
The DLC will add new content including 13 new weapons: Hammers.
Try the new playstyle hammer weapon!


[h2]Other bug fixes[\h2]
Fixed an issue where the boss, Pengranger, would occasionally launch out of the map.
Fixed an issue where some clear achievements were not applied properly.
Fixed window (title) interaction in Lucy's room to work more easily.
Fixed an issue where equipment and items were sometimes not acquired in the Encyclopedia.

Other fixes

notes.title: Diary of Lucie is released now!
notes.content:
Hello, here is parange project.

Diary of Lucie is finally officially released!
Please check the patch notes below for more information.


[h3]1. Add a story[/h3]
Stories and endings that have not been revealed so far have been added.
You can meet Lucie, her diary, and the hidden stories of the characters.


[h3]2. Haegeum content[/h3]
In fact, if Lucie's diary was closer to the log-like genre,
The true loglight is from the full version with the addition of Haegeum content.
I think even users who previously had difficulty in playing games will be able to enjoy it more as they play.

1. the inner mind
Content that can be released using credits that can be obtained during the game.
As you play the game, more minds are lifted, and you can give the player new skills or even release another content or new level of difficulty

2. Title system
You can combine the titles you get while playing the game and apply them to Lucie.
It is also possible to change the play style to suit the player's taste and to strengthen certain weapon builds.
The title is available in various ways and achievements throughout the game.

3. Achievements
Various achievements in the game are newly added.
It is also possible to achieve achievements and earn new rewards.
The achievements can be found in the Steam Library and also in the in-game ring command menu.

4. Accessories
You can acquire various accessories while playing the game.
Accessories are given special unique options according to the enhancement steps and are not initialized in the inventory even if they die.
The higher the level of difficulty you play, the higher the level of accessories you can get.


[h3]3. Item change[/h3]
The description and utilization of the item have been added more intuitively.
A total of more than 20 types of upper-level items with an uncommon grade or higher have been added.

In addition, high-level items can be used in various ways with the Haegeum content and growth factors added below.
For example, you can play multiple rounds to upgrade a particular weapon endlessly.
You can also significantly inflate your assets while maintaining a portion of your holdings.

And quick slot and quick item use function have been added.
Quick slots include potions or food items added this time (for example, the ability to stop for 3 seconds in an invincible state). 
Items required immediately for combat situations are automatically registered and can be changed to shortcut keys.
( Items that are not required for combat situations, such as incant scrolls, will not be registered in the quick slot)

In addition, a number of contents such as reinforcement capabilities and incantation types are added for each weapon.
Items that were previously low in use or ambiguous in value have been changed or removed.


[h3]4. Changes in the union system[/h3]
The combination recipe is more than doubled compared to the previous one, and the efficiency of the combination is increased.

In fact, the existing combination system had limited items that could be combined, and it was difficult to use the combined items.
Increase the return value for the combination results, add food items, and unique grade equipment,
And we changed as many builds as possible, such as hidden recipes, so that users can adopt them.


[h3]5. Changes in durability system[/h3]
The durability system was originally intended to use a variety of weapons. 
I wanted to induce them to use low-grade weapons.

But rather, the stress that comes from breaking the weapon, 
I thought that limited durability recovery was a problem.

So, I'm trying to control the durability of the weapon.
We have also changed weapons that have broken repair items such as anvil grandfather, whetstone, and Mana's stone to be repaired again.


[h3]6. Skill changes[/h3]
Eight new skills and 26 skill databases have been added.
Most existing skill balances have been adjusted, and have now been changed to make them more efficient at higher levels.

And the more you use the skill, the more you remove the existing system that was able to level up.
You have changed it so that you can acquire the same skill or raise the skill level to a specific item.


[h3]7. Ability Changes [/h3]
Seven new possibilities have been added.
Ability's name has been changed to 'Property' to suit the main story worldview.

In addition, when acquiring a holy object from a box, we changed it so that you can choose from a number of holy objects.
Added to your options to preview the ability of the castle.


[h3]8. Add new stage and boss[/h3]
The new stage and the final boss for that stage are added.


[h3]9. Improved lagging[/h3]
In fact, it's the optimization part that I've been focusing on the most.
It greatly alleviated the lag in a low-end environment.

In particular, it greatly improved the phenomenon that the more the game continues to be played, and the more the lag gets after the third stage.
Although it cannot be completely solved due to the limitations of development tools, we will continue to improve this area.



I think I've had a big challenge for 5 years as a one-man developer.
There were so many setbacks.
I think I was able to come this far without giving up because there were people who waited and cheered for my game.
We will continue to work hard and update to repay the expectations of many people.

All the music in the game is composed and played by yourself, and you can use it freely on YouTube or streaming.



[h3]Other bug fixes[\h3]
Fixed a inner heart that was not saved normally.
After activating the characteristics of the inner mind, we corrected the phenomenon that the characteristics could not be recalled when the game was reconnected.
We fixed the phenomenon that the black screen appears when we move to the next area after the 10th floor.
We have fixed the phenomenon of dropping the accessory box when clearing the boss, even if the characteristics are not unbanned sometimes.
We fixed the phenomenon that the effect was not output normally among the Boss Ione patterns.
Fixed an intermittent sharp decrease in movement speed during game play.
Fixed a phenomenon where the title gambler effect was not applied.
We have corrected the phenomenon that the potion item was not consumed when obtaining the holy umbrella.
Fixed a phenomenon where the clear achievement was not applied normally.
I did not acquire a necklace in the tutorial and corrected the phenomenon that did not progress in the library.
Fixed a duplicate increase in some capabilities during save loading.
We have corrected the phenomenon that coin items did not work properly or fell without cause since the middle part.
We fixed the phenomenon that the game stopped with a low probability when dealing with Pengsolzer, ghost, and fairy at stage 4 or higher.
(Gamepad) Fixed a phenomenon where the skill was not changed to a cross key.
Fixed a phenomenon where the non-steamina-consuming effect was not applied in certain situations.
Corrected the phenomenon that sometimes descriptive statements were not printed properly when acquiring properties in the box.
The tutorial and some stories have corrected the typos.


(Additional)
Boss Pengranger fixed the phenomenon that sometimes fires off the map.
Fixed a phenomenon where some clear achievements were not properly applied.

notes.title: Early Access 1.2.9 Main Update and Announcement of Full Version Release
notes.content:
[h1]Early Access 1.2.9 Main Update Guide[/h1]

Hello, Here is Parange Project.

First of all, I have to apologize for the delay in the release of the official version before explaining this update.
The development of the official version is steadily progressing, but we couldn't ignore the disappointing parts, so we proceeded with more work to improve the completeness.

Along with the contents of this update, I will share the contents, development status, and future progress plan that will be added in the official version.

[h3]This update will be applied in both English and Korean.[/h3]


[h2]Update Content[/h2]

[h3]Weapon [/h3]
A subdivision has been added to the weapon category.
We wanted to add some rules and characteristics to the existing weapons category to enhance the individuality of each weapon

- Cane
After change: Cane(Magic specialization), Wand(Attack specialization)
- Bow
After change: Short bow(fast general attack), Long bow(long range and strong attack), Crossbow
- Sword
After change: Sword(5 consecutive attacks), Great Sword(slow speed and wide range, strong attack), Dual Sword (fast consecutive hits and attacks)

Most weapons special attack mechanisms have changed
- Cand(Wand): Short charging requirements, multiple shots fired
- Bow: Add attack and motion that quickly scatters four arrows quickly
- Sword: 3 stacks later attack with multiple hits and short-time incapacitation

In addition, the benefits of low-grade weapons are too low and the efficiency of high-grade weapons is too high in the early stages 
The higher the grade of the weapon, the more balance penalties were added.


[h3]Skill[/h3]
You have changed the skill acquired at level-up to allow duplicate acquisition.
Previously, the same probability allowed the skill to be duplicated 
This alone made it difficult to reach a sufficient level of the desired skill.
The skills gained by the level-up are now frequently featured, and special effects descriptions for the level-up are added.

I changed it so that the skill that has already achieved the highest level does not appear during level-up.

I applied invincibility to skills that do not apply invincible time during skill demonstration.

[h3][/h3]
You have added an Ability item to the drawing list.
You can now see the list and effectiveness in the Ability Diagram you acquired.



[h2]Announcement of the release of the official version[/h2]
The following content will be added in the full version:

[h3]Unlock Content [/h3]

2. Title system
It can be applied to Lucy by combining titles that can be obtained by playing the game.
It is also possible to change the play style to suit the player's taste, or to strengthen a specific weapon build.

3. Achievements
Various achievements in the game will be added.
It is also possible to achieve new rewards by achieving achievements.

Depending on the level of difficulty you play, you will also be able to obtain accessories (rings, necklaces) with powerful special options.

So far, Diary of Lucie has been close to the log-like genre.

[h3]Add a story[/h3]

In addition, new stages, new bosses, synergy of existing attributes,

The official version will be released in October this year.

notes.title: 1.2.4 Patch note
notes.content:
[h1] Early Access 1.2.4 Main Update Information [/h1]
Hello, this is Parange Project.

In this update, we'll get user's feedback, modify UI/UX, add a encyclopedia,
content update and balancing were performed.
For this update, only Korean will be updated first, and foreign languages will be supported later.

And Diary of Lucie will hold a 30% discount event to commemorate the Black Friday promotion.
Also, we're going to increase the price while preparing for the official version.
The price change will be applied after the promotion discount is over.

In addition, official version will be released in the first quarter of next year.
We wanted to release it as soon as possible, but We needed a preparation period for the content to be added and better storytelling production.

As you waited for a long time, we will complete the game with more satisfaction.



[h2] Content update[/h2]

[h3] Weapon[/h3]
[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/28ae57ac-efa9-432e-bca0-c4003518dd9f/dev4rqy-c77e2172-3f92-42b0-8a16-0ff7ff52c163.png?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..6RoNjTlsXIAyPCMrUJkVuBAYyIXt8oOgq4U3yKwVkNk[/img]
The ability of special effects given every 3, 6, and 9 stages of weapon reinforcement has been raised.
We tried to compensate for the lack of merit in strengthening existing weapons.
Each special effect given by a yellow line is engraved with a unique name, and figures are randomly given.

In addition, the reinforcement level of weapons acquired from the weapon box changes when the boss is cleared.
Previously, it was only possible up to the second round, but the higher the number of floors, the higher the probability of advanced weapons appearing.

However, in order to prevent excessive increase in attack power, the stats were randomly raised among attack power and magic power when strengthening weapons.

The special effect effect has been modified or added when strengthening the weapon below.
- Mana amplification.
- Enlarging mana.
- Rewind.
- Strengthen the speed.
- The footsteps of the wind.
- Lightness.
- Diamond.
- Strong bow.
- Blessing.
- Strengthen your body.
- Quick.
- Vitality.
- Wave.
- Balance.


The stack effect of the sword has been changed.
Compared to other existing weapons, the preference of the sword and the visibility of special attacks were lower.
To ensure the identity and return of the sword, we changed the stack effect as follows.

- If you hit the sword 3 times, you'll get one more stack.
- Change the effect of 3 stacks.
Previously: Damage of special attacks increased by 200%.
After change: When using a special attack after 3 stacks, use of one island skill according to the weapon type.

It increased the risk and return of cane charging attacks.
- A slight increase in the demand for charging of a charge attack.
- Damage of charge attack increased.

The demi control rate of the bow's basic attack decreased slightly.


The capability of the weapon below will be changed.

Existing: Physical properties
After changing: Ice properties

- Changing the nature of the basic attack on KAR League's Idea.
Previously: Non-property.
After changing: Physical properties

- Cerberus special effect change.
Previously: 20% increase in physical damage.
After change: Darkness property damage increased by 20%


[h3] Defense gear[/h3]
[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/28ae57ac-efa9-432e-bca0-c4003518dd9f/dev4rsc-f8bd13e2-5953-44df-86d9-4e60c39e1249.png?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..7Z-7scUNYdqYeM0mX3nrditABkenDTjkBE-NIH2x68M[/img]
After adding the set effect with the last update, the performance of the high-grade single armor was too good.
The performance of several single combinations is higher than that of the set, which has reduced the effectiveness of low-grade armor and set armor.
Therefore, the performance was adjusted so that the low-grade armor or set effect could have its own characteristics.

The effect of the set armor below has been changed.
- Sailor Lucy (1 set effect eliminated)
- Traveler Lucy (1 set effect removed, 2 sets effect increased).
- Lucy from Wonderland. (1 set effect removed, 3 set effect increased)
- Liar Lucy. (1 set effect removed, 3 sets effect increased)
- Adult Lucy (1 set effect removed, 3 sets effect increased)
- Lucy of the Dead Star. (1 set effect eliminated, 2 sets effect reduced)
- Daehyunja Lucy. (1 set effect eliminated, 2 set effect decreased)
- Guardian of Libra. (1 set effect eliminated, 2nd and 3rd set effect decreased.


[h3] Item[/h3]
We adjusted the drop rate of items and item boxes.
As the rounds are repeated, we want to make up for the stress caused by items with low return values and insufficient inventory.
And the value and effectiveness of some items have been increased by adjusting the drop rate of general items.
After testing the drop rate, we would like to increase the effectiveness of more combination items in the future.

When the monster room is cleared, the drop rate of the item box has been lowered.
Visibility has been adjusted to make the item box look good on the grade.

The effect of the item below has been changed.
- Whetstone.
Previously: 40 recovery of the durability of weapons.
After changing: Weapon's durability restored to 60

- Mana's stone.
Previously: 50% recovery of the durability of the weapon, 4 recovery of Mana.
After the change: 50% recovery of the durability of the weapon, 50% recovery of the mana.

- Green potion.
Previously: 2nd recovery of physical strength.
After changing: 3 physical strength recovery

- Purple potion.
Previously: 3rd recovery of physical strength.
After the change: Four physical strength recovery


[h3]Encyclopedia[/h3]
[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/28ae57ac-efa9-432e-bca0-c4003518dd9f/dev4rsz-8e0564e4-1d35-4458-80d0-faec3e2f2a4c.png?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..I5k_t4uQi7ihQVmtd6q9qPF7BrPm4gjWtWuuTerDyLo[/img]
Encyclopedia has been added.
The added drawings are weaponry, armor, item drawings, and skill drawings, and we are also preparing to link achievements according to the collection rate and overall drawing achievement.
As there were many feedback, we wanted to make the synopsis of various categories as simple and more visible as possible.


[h2] Convenience improvement. [/h2]

[h3] Link command[/h3]
I changed the link command UI and operation method.
As it accounts for a large portion of the feedback, it is changed to be more intuitive than the existing method.
When using the keyboard and mouse, rotate the link command icon, and the menu opens with a click without having to select.
Even when using the controller, the menu opens at once by touching the stick at that angle without the need for rotation and selection buttons.
In addition, a drawing and achievement category has been added to the link command (the achievement will be added in the next update).


[h3] Steam Cloud Linkage Support[/h3]
Steam cloud interworking function has been added when using the steam version.
Cloud save features are now available to link saves on other computers!
In addition, the achievement achievement function that applies to the account when obtaining the achievement is ready, but this will be added in the next update.


[h3] Shortening key. [/h3]
I added the shortcut key below so that you can change it on the setting screen.
- Avoidance key.
- 1st to 4th skill keys.
(For those who changed the shortcut key, it will be reset after the update, so please reset it later.)


[h3] Controller[/h3]
The default value of the link command menu has been changed from the existing Y button to the LB button for smooth operation.

The controller's skill switching method has been changed.
Previously: Choose left and right cross buttons.
After changing: Select the skills assigned to the four cross buttons.


[h2] Bug Fix[/h2]
We fixed the problem of not being able to reflect the ghost's ammunition with a sword on the lava stage.
In the lava stage boss match, we modified the phenomenon that sometimes went out of the map when using the island skill.
I modified it so that link command can be called even when the inventory is open when using a mouse.
I modified the description of the dash, avoidance, and link command tutorial pages.
We modified the phenomenon that the indicator icon was not properly output in the tutorial forest.
I modified the tutorial forest to correspond to both the changed key and the controller key.
When using a controller, modify the skill so that the skill does not change when the direction key is pressed in the minimap or inventory.



Thank you to everyone who supports Diary of Lucie

notes.title: 1.2.1 Patch note
notes.content:
[h1] Early Access 1.2.1 Main Update Information [/h1]
Hello, Here is Parange Project.

The overall balancing work was carried out along with the addition of new content.
For this update, only Korean will be updated first, and foreign languages will be supported later.

[h2]Fatigue problem[/h2]
As I continued to update, I felt that the fatigue of playing the game increased a lot.
We decided to reduce the fatigue of the game while reducing unnecessary parts for the game progress.
- Changed the default inventory capacity from 10 to 15.
- The number of items displayed in the store now increases as you purchase items from the store. Buy several items you need to attack from the beginning of the game!
- Increased the amount of gold drop in the item box and the gold drop rate of monsters.
- The 4 existing enchantment scrolls are combined into one enchantment scroll. When using the integrated enchantment scroll, you can select the desired area to enchant.
- Simplified clear direction when clearing the boss.
Temporarily restricted access to stage 4 lucid dreaming. After the official release, the 4th stage expansion will be revealed.


[h2] Balance Update[/h2]
Existing skills could not intuitively check how much power the skill had when acquired.
It was also difficult to distinguish whether it was a magic power-based skill or an attack power-based skill.
So, there seems to have been a problem of fixation by avoiding various skill builds and continuing to use only the skills that were used.

From this version, when acquiring a skill, the skill description UI has been modified, and most skill balances have been corrected.
I decided to try adding new skills.
Along with skill balancing, the level-specific characteristics of some existing skills have also been changed.
I hope this update develops to be able to utilize various skills.

London-Rondo

fire sphere

railgun

The following new skills have been added.

explosion punch
- A new fire element explosion punch has been added. Inflicts a ranged attack based on physical damage and applies a burn debuff.

notes.title: 1.2.0 Patch note & Discount offer
notes.content:
[h1]Early Access 1.2.0 Main Update Guide[/h1]
Hello, this is the Parange Project.

In this update, a lot of items were added along with the addition of a combination system.
It has become possible to play using the strategic item build-up that was lacking before.
In addition, weapons reinforcement systems, remakes of the Incant system, etc.
I worked to improve the completeness of the contents in the game.

And bug fixes, including early tutorial bugs, which were fatal errors in the progress of the game.
We have improved user convenience by adding controller support function and modifying UI.

Japanese language support will be applied to the next update.

We are updating the story mode as well as updating the content.
Please look forward to Lucie's story, which will be released with the official release.

Diary of Lucie offers a 20% discount for the steam summer sale!


[h2]Add Compatible System[/h2]
You can now combine the two items using the Combination tab in the inventory.
We will add a combined system tutorial later.

In the union window, you can make a new item by combining two items.
Basically, there are combination recipes only for categories such as items, weapons, or armor.
Some exceptions may exist.

If it's your first time trying a combination recipe, you won't know the result until you try it.
However, if the combination was successful with the same combination recipe before, you can check the results in advance from next time.
Try as many combinations as possible as you can get new ingredients with the powder of wise man that comes out of failure!

64 new general items have been added.
Marie's store has started selling 45 new regular items.
Regular items can be dropped by a monster, or acquired from a box that appears occasionally when clearing the monster room.


[h2] Inorganic reinforcement system remake[/h2]
Previously, the capacity increased in proportion to the performance of the weapon itself when reinforced.
So there was a huge difference in the reinforcement performance of low-level and high-level weapons.
Low-level weapons rarely felt the need to be strengthened.
In the case of certain weapons, the penalty of the equipment was also strengthened, so there was no need for further reinforcement.
The meaning of the reinforcement system was blurred because there were no restrictions on the number of reinforcement attempts or attempts.

In the remade reinforcement system, inorganic performance grows to a fixed value every step of reinforcement.
Therefore, the lower the basic performance of low-level weapons, the more reinforcement efficiency correction.
And at certain stages, new special effects are added, increasing the high-reinforced merit.
The higher the reinforcement level, the higher the maximum durability, which adds to the reinforcement efficiency.

However, when the level of reinforcement is high, there is a probability of failure to strengthen, so the maximum durability may decrease.
We need to choose reinforcement carefully and strategically.

44 new special effects have been added due to weapons reinforcement figures.


[h2]Enchant Remake[/h2]
Enchant is no longer dropped from the middle boss box.
In addition, prefixes and suffixes for each part that existed separately were integrated into random incantations.
From this version, when using In-Chant Scroll, two types of In-Chant will be randomly given.

Ten new invitations will be added in the next minor update.

4 types of new incantations have been added.
The below incantations have been deleted or changed.
Blacksmith Enchant (maximum reinforcement added)
Giant (increase in ammunition size in proportion to attack force)
Preparation (increase speed depending on physical strength)
Energy (no use for 2 seconds when the stamina is full).
Beginner (Increases magic power when there are less than two skills)
Intensive (the less mana you have, the more magical you are)
Excitement (the more physical you lose, the more aggressive you are).


[h2]Added Controller Feature Support[/h2]
Added UI and function support for Xbox controller.
Gamepad is now available in most gameplay.
Minimap's room movement function will be applied in the next update.

Improved aim calibration when using controller.


[h2]Fight Frame Optimization[/h2]
It has improved overall frame optimization in combat, especially the previously very severe four-stage frame drop.
However, there are parts that have not been fully optimized yet, so we would like to improve them by the next update.


[h2]Modify attack speed calculation method[/h2]
The existing attack speed calculation formula was being applied incorrectly.
At a low level, the attack speed was not felt, and it was only possible to achieve extreme efficiency at the highest point.

From this version, the attack speed calculation formula will be modified to be applied properly.
Also, we removed the existing upper 80% attack speed limit.

The attack speed stets of the below Ability will be changed.
Slap Guntlet 10->20
honeycomb 20->30
Sacred relics 10->15
Stone of Chow Moon 25->
Boyd 5->10
Luminous Mushroom 35->50

Attack speed stets that were only on some swords will be removed.


[h2]Reorganization and modification of convenience[/h2]
[b]1. UI Improvement[/b]
Added to display current and maximum durability above the inorganic icon of HUD.
The gold you currently have has been added to the top right.
The HUD has been improved so that it is not covered with transparency when entering the boss battle.

[b]2. Modify Balance by Weapon Category[/b]
Now, depending on the level of the weapon, the stamina or consumption of the attack increases.
Depending on the grade of the weapon, the capabilities that were applied randomly are eliminated.
Fixed capability is added for each type of weapon.
Cane: Up to 1 mana increase
Bow: 1 increase in travel speed
Sword: 10% increase in attack speed

[b]3. Skills[/b]
FIRE SPEARS: Upgraded window single-hit damage coefficient.
Vortex: Downgraded damage coefficient for level 3 additional hits.
EASQUAKE: The damage coefficient has been lowered.
Ice Crystal: Now it doesn't slow down the enemy, but it keeps freezing.
ALPHRAZOLAM: The explosion range has increased.
Added a new skill explosion punch.

[b]4. Other[/b]
Two new types of availability have been added.
Ability capabilities below will be modified.
Hunter's Instinct: 25 percent to 30 percent movement speed.
Adrenaline: 25%–30% attack speed
Nzt-49: Reduced Reuse 30%->25%
String-Violin: Fatal hit probability 30%–>25%

Added a description that applies the default value of autorun after tutorial clear to ON.

Added upper limit of gold acquisition for the Bloody Fountain, Mana Fountain.


[h2]modify bug[/h2]
- After obtaining most of the availability in Stage 4, we corrected the occasional error when entering the next room.
- Fixed a phenomenon in which the maximum number of rooms is higher than the maximum with a low probability when creating a map on stage 4.

Thank you always for supporting Diary of Lucie and waiting.

Accordingly, items with the option to reduce stamina consumption while running were temporarily applied as an option to increase stamina recovery speed.
We plan to properly explain options through item reorganization in the future.
